It is commonly referred to as "the cloud". In the SaaS model, cloud providers install and operate application software in the cloud and cloud users access the software from cloud clients. Cloud users do not manage the cloud infrastructure and platform where the application runs. Cloud deployment models define the fundamental patterns of interaction between cloud customers and cloud providers. Gartner defines a hybrid cloud service as a cloud computing service that is composed of some combination of private, public and community cloud services, from different service providers.

5G is used for mobile broadband, fixed wireless access , private and industrial networks, and machine-type communications. The highest 5G speed measured in a deployed network is 5.9 Gbit/s (2023). The release introduces AI- and ML-based network management, extended-reality services, and communication support for autonomous systems. Before and during early 5G deployment, some mobile network operators used terms such as "pre-5G", "5G-ready", "4.5G", and "5G Evolution" for upgraded LTE Advanced or LTE Advanced Pro networks. These networks could use features such as carrier aggregation , 256-QAM, and 4×4 MIMO to increase data rates, but they did not use 5G NR , the radio access technology standardized for 5G networks.

A self-driving car , also known as an autonomous car , driverless car , robotic car , or robo-car , is a car that is capable of operating with reduced or no human input . Autonomy implies that an automation system is under the control of the vehicle rather than a driver. A safety driver was in the car. Computer security (also cybersecurity , digital security , or information technology ( IT ) security ) is a subdiscipline within the field of information security . Vulnerability management is integral to computer security and network security . Hardware-based or assisted computer security also offers an alternative to software-only computer security. As with physical security , the motivations for breaches of computer security vary between attackers. Since 2010, Canada has had a cyber security strategy.
